message.abstract:
<jats:title>A<jats:sc>bstract</jats:sc>
                     </jats:title><jats:p>We discuss the non-relativistic limit of string theory in AdS<jats:sub>5</jats:sub>×S<jats:sup>5</jats:sup> for different choices of embedding coordinates. We show that, if we consider Cartesian coordinates, the action of fluctuations around the twisted BMN-like string found in <jats:ext-link xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" ext-link-type="uri" xlink:href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.13240">arXiv:2109.13240</jats:ext-link> in uniform light-cone gauge becomes the one of free fields at large string tension and large AdS<jats:sub>5</jats:sub> radius.</jats:p>
title: Light-cone gauge in non-relativistic AdS5×S5 string theory
